target.title: fix(litellm): honor Anthropic cache retention
target.body:
Closes #37966

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where users routing Claude models through LiteLLM could explicitly set `cacheRetention`, but OpenClaw still dropped the Anthropic `cache_control` prompt-cache markers before sending the OpenAI-compatible request. That made LiteLLM-proxied Claude usage miss the expected prompt-cache behavior and its cost/latency benefits.

## Why This Change Was Made

This keeps LiteLLM's OpenAI-compatible path conservative: only model IDs that look like Claude/Anthropic get Anthropic cache-control shaping, and only when the caller explicitly set `cacheRetention`. Non-Claude LiteLLM models and LiteLLM Claude models without explicit cache retention keep the existing plain payload behavior.

## User Impact

Users can now configure `cacheRetention: "short"` or `cacheRetention: "long"` for LiteLLM-proxied Claude models and have OpenClaw forward Anthropic `cache_control` markers through LiteLLM. Existing LiteLLM configs without explicit cache retention are unchanged.

## Evidence

- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/prompt-cache-retention.test.ts src/llm/providers/stream-wrappers/anthropic-family-cache-semantics.test.ts src/llm/providers/openai-completions.test.ts` — PASS, 2 Vitest shards, 56 tests.
- `corepack pnpm exec oxfmt --check src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/prompt-cache-retention.test.ts src/llm/providers/openai-completions.ts src/llm/providers/openai-completions.test.ts src/llm/providers/stream-wrappers/anthropic-family-cache-semantics.ts src/llm/providers/stream-wrappers/anthropic-family-cache-semantics.test.ts docs/providers/litellm.md` — PASS.
- `corepack pnpm exec oxlint --config .oxlintrc.json --tsconfig config/tsconfig/oxlint.core.json src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/prompt-cache-retention.test.ts src/llm/providers/openai-completions.ts src/llm/providers/openai-completions.test.ts src/llm/providers/stream-wrappers/anthropic-family-cache-semantics.ts src/llm/providers/stream-wrappers/anthropic-family-cache-semantics.test.ts` — PASS, 0 warnings/errors.
- `corepack pnpm lint:docs -- docs/providers/litellm.md` — PASS, 0 errors.
- `git diff --check` — PASS.
- Diff secret scan — PASS.

Live LiteLLM-to-Anthropic cache read/write proof was not run because this change was validated with deterministic payload-shaping tests and no test LiteLLM proxy credentials were available in this checkout.

target.title: fix(watch): defer restart when dist/entry.js is missing mid-rebuild
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

When a `git push` triggers source file changes while `dist/` is mid-rebuild, the hot-reload watcher (`watch-node.mjs`) unconditionally kills the current healthy gateway child process and restarts into a missing or stale `dist/entry.js`, causing a crash-loop that exhausts systemd's restart limit (37-minute outage).

Fixes [#99603](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/99603).

## Why This Change Was Made

`requestRestart()` in `scripts/watch-node.mjs` sent SIGTERM to the child process without verifying build readiness. The fix adds `isBuildReadyForRestart()` which validates:

1. **`dist/entry.js` exists** — basic mid-rebuild guard
2. **Build stamp git HEAD matches current checkout HEAD** — aligns with `run-node`'s `resolveBuildRequirement` contract, preventing restarts into a stale build from a different commit (e.g. after `git pull`)

If the build is not ready, the watcher polls every 200ms. When the build completes, it proceeds with the restart. A **5-minute timeout** prevents infinite polling — the current process keeps running and the next file change will retry.

**Child-exit during deferral**: If the child process exits while waiting for build readiness, the exit handler also defers restart until the build is ready instead of restarting immediately into a potentially broken `dist/`.

## User Impact

- **Before**: Source file changes during mid-rebuild → watcher kills healthy gateway → new child cannot start → crash-loop → systemd gives up → outage
- **After**: Source file changes during mid-rebuild or after `git pull` → watcher waits for `dist/entry.js` + matching build stamp → build completes → safe restart. Guards prevent both the immediate kill and premature restart on child exit.

## Evidence

### Unit Tests (18/18 passed)
- `defers restart when dist/entry.js is missing` — build readiness guard
- `kills child normally when dist/entry.js exists` — normal path unaffected
- `gives up after timeout when build never completes` — timeout safety net

### Real Machine Gateway:Watch Proof (Linux x64, Node 22.19)

**完整终端日志** (当前 HEAD `603df8ffd8`, 已编辑路径):

```
============================================================
  Issue #99603 — 真机验证完整日志
  fix(watch): defer restart when dist/ is mid-rebuild
============================================================

Host:     LIN-DF11F9C3F26.zte.intra
Kernel:   4.19.112-2.el8.x86_64
Node:     v22.19.0
Git HEAD: 603df8ffd8
Branch:   fix/issue-99603-watch-node-guard

=== 命令: 启动 gateway:watch ===
$ OPENCLAW_SKIP_CHANNELS=1 node scripts/watch-node.mjs gateway

watcher PID:  2443610

=== 进程状态 (就绪后) ===
$ ps -p 2443610 -o pid,stat,etime,comm
2443610 Sl 00:30 node                    ← watcher 进程健康
$ ps -p 2443620 -o pid,stat,etime,comm
2443620 Ssl 00:30 node                   ← 子进程健康

============================================================
  Phase 1: mid-rebuild (entry 缺失 + stamp 过期)
============================================================

$ # 伪造旧 stamp（模拟 git pull 前）+ 删除 dist/entry.js
$ echo '{"builtAt":1700000000000,"head":"ffffffff..."}' > dist/.buildstamp
$ rm dist/entry.js

$ # 触发源文件变更 → requestRestart
$ touch src/entry.ts

--- watcher 输出 ---
[openclaw] Build output not ready (dist/entry.js missing or stale); waiting before restart.
→ ✅ 双层 guard 正确 defer（entry 缺失 + stamp 过期）

============================================================
  Phase 2: 恢复 entry 但 stamp 仍过期 (git pull 模拟)
============================================================

$ cp /tmp/proof-entry.js dist/entry.js   # 恢复 entry.js
$ # stamp HEAD 仍为 ffffffff（过期）

--- watcher 输出 ---
[openclaw] Build output not ready (dist/entry.js missing or stale); waiting before restart.
→ ✅ stamp 对齐检查生效 (entry 存在但 HEAD 不匹配 → 仍 defer)

============================================================
  Phase 3: 恢复正确 stamp → 安全重启
============================================================

$ cp /tmp/proof-stamp.json dist/.buildstamp  # 恢复正确 stamp (HEAD: 603df8ffd8)

--- watcher 输出（最终）---
[openclaw] Build output ready; proceeding with restart.
[openclaw] Syncing runtime artifacts (build_stamp_newer).
→ ✅ stamp 匹配 → guard 通过 → 安全重启

============================================================
  验证结论
============================================================
  ✅ Guard 阻止了 crash (defer restart)
  ✅ build 就绪后安全重启
  ✅ watcher 进程全程健康 (alive)

对比 MAIN 分支 (无修复):
  [openclaw] Building TypeScript (dist is stale: missing_dist_entry)
  → kill 健康子进程 → crash loop → systemd 耗尽重启限额
```

**测试流程**: `OPENCLAW_SKIP_CHANNELS=1 node scripts/watch-node.mjs gateway` → 等待就绪 → `rm dist/entry.js && touch src/entry.ts` → watcher 检测到 build 未就绪 → 等待 → `cp` 恢复 `dist/entry.js` → watcher 检测就绪 → 安全重启

**验证通过项**:
- ✅ mid-rebuild 检测: Guard 阻止了 crash
- ✅ build stamp HEAD 对齐: 与 run-node 就绪检查一致
- ✅ 安全恢复: build 就绪后自动重启
- ✅ watcher 进程始终保持健康

## Changes

5 commits, 3 files (+258/-5):

- `scripts/watch-node.mjs` (+108): `isBuildReadyForRestart` with entry check + build stamp HEAD alignment via `resolveGitHead`; `deps.fs` injection; guard in `requestRestart` with 200ms polling + 5-min timeout; child-exit guard with bounded recovery (5-min timeout then fallback `startRunner`); both guards skip in test mode (`OPENCLAW_WATCH_MODE=test`)
- `src/infra/watch-node.test.ts` (+159/-1): 3 new tests covering guard, normal path, and timeout behavior. `startWatchRun` defaults test mode to preserve test isolation
- `test/scripts/lint-suppressions.test.ts` (+1): register `oxlint-disable-next-line` suppression in production allowlist

Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>
